title: Datetime and Timestamp Format Violations
description: Validation of temporal data formats, ambiguous day/month orderings, and missing timezone specifications.
conditions: Temporal data collected across international systems (e.g., DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY)
Epoch timestamps mixed with ISO-8601 strings
Timezone offsets missing in longitudinal or time-series event data
recommended_methods: Ambiguity detection on dates where day <= 12
Explicit format string parsing with strict fallback handling
selection_rules: If date format is ambiguous (03/04/2026), inspect adjacent dates in file to deduce regional convention
Always normalize all timestamps to UTC ISO-8601 strings with timezone offset
If timestamp falls in the future relative to ingestion time, flag as an invalid temporal event
limitations: Inference engines like dateutil can silently misparse mixed date formats within the same column
Daylight savings transitions create non-existent or duplicate local timestamps
